correctness.rationale: Rewrite squared cost for X∼Π_d, V uniform as 2d/3−2E[(ΣX_i)V]; Hardy–Littlewood rearrangement yields the unique comonotone coupling V=F_d(ΣX_i), since ΣX_i is continuous. Symmetrization gives Q_d=d/6−H_d/2 with H_d=E|Σ_i(U_i−U_i′)|. Sums of 2d uniforms and Irwin–Hall integration prove exact finite formula. The characteristic function of each difference is a(t)=sinc²(t/2)∈[0,1], so H_d=(2/π)∫(1−a^d)/t² and its strict first- and second-difference signs prove Q_d strictly convex and increasing from Q1=0. Controlled log-sinc expansion yields asymptotic Q_d=d/6−sqrt(d/(12π))(1+1/(40d)+O(d^−2)). Independently computed exact rational Q1..Q6: 0,1/10,181/840,1537/4536,373057/798336,22215929/37065600 and checked first/second finite differences, not a proof of for-all-d.
